jobs.title: Data Business Analyst x 3 (Banking & Finance)
jobs.description: Data Business Analyst x 3 – Banking & Finance, PM-Partners Group, Sydney CBD (Contract/Temp). PM-Partners Group is seeking three Business Analysts with data management experience for a large banking group in a global markets division. 6 month Contracts + Extensions available. Flexible remote work or Sydney CBD. The role requires at least five years of BA experience in banking and finance, proficiency with SQL, and skills with enterprise data principles and big data platform tools. Applications to Paul Micallef at PM-Partners via SEEK or by email.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Machine Learning Engineer at Elula, Sydney CBD and Inner West. Full-time with flexible work arrangements, posted 22 days ago. Requires strong programming in at least one language such as Python, R, Scala or Java; commercial experience building and automating big data pipelines on cloud platforms, preferably AWS, using tools like Spark or Glue; expertise with SQL and relational databases; and experience producing production-grade data models. Experience in financial services or retail banking, and familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps, are listed as optional extras. Applicants must submit a CV and a cover letter explaining what draws them to Elula and the job.
